## #4 — Martin — 2012-09-14
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/8805/post-73173>

Hi,
did you check the right folder? They should be installed at the following path: 

    ~/Library/Application Support/Cheetah3D/Scripts

Bye
Martin

## #6 — Martin — 2012-09-14
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/8805/post-73187>

Hi,
that's strange. Maybe try to delete the scripts folder and restart Cheetah3D. At start-up Cheetah3D should copy the script into that folder.

Maybe the scripts folder got accidentally write protected. So far I never had the case that the scripts didn't get installed properly.

Bye
Martin
